Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Introduction
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will support the development and deployment of advanced AI solutions, focusing on Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI applications. Your key responsibilities will include developing, training, and optimizing ML/DL models, adapting and integrating LLMs, contributing to Generative AI and Agentic AI initiatives, building scalable ML engineering pipelines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
 Preferred Education
 Master's Degree
 Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Strong proficiency in Python
Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch and/or TensorFlow
Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs)
Solid background in Machine Learning Engineering, including model deployment and lifecycle management
Hands-on experience with at least two cloud-based platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, IBM Cloud or GCP
Proficiency in French and English languages
 Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
Experience with Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks or applications
Familiarity with MLOps practices and cloud-based ML environments
Knowledge of AI model evaluation, fine-tuning, and optimization techniques
Experience developing ML/DL solutions in production environments
Familiarity with optimizing the performance of ML solutions is desirable to ensure they remain efficient and effective.
Familiarity with collaboration tools and version control systems
